blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Exocentric-to-egocentric (Exo2Ego) video generation transforms third-person recordings into first-person viewpoints, unlocking immersive AR/VR experiences and scalable demonstration synthesis for embodied robotics. Extending it to a streaming setting is expected to further enable live applications. However, existing methods suffer from degraded manipulation regions, overfitting and confinement to fixed-length clips with prohibitive latency. To address these limitations, we present StreamEgo, a real-time framework for unbounded, generalizable Exo2Ego video generation. To resolve intricate manipulation dynamics while supporting the streaming pipeline, a streaming dual-branch prior provides pixel-aligned guidance for translating appearance and skeletal kinematics. We also introduce a region-aware loss curriculum to improve generalization and stabilize multi-objective diffusion training. Furthermore, we distill the model into a chunk-wise autoregressive model, augmented with a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum, enabling high-quality, generalizable real-time streaming Exo2Ego generation at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU.
blocks.zh: 异心对异心(Exo2Ego)视频生成将第三人称录音转换成第一人称视角,解锁浸润的AR/VR体验和可缩放的演示合成,用于体现的机器人. 将它扩展至流媒体环境,可望进一步实现实时应用。 然而,现有方法因操纵区域退化而受到影响,过于适应,并被固定长度的短片夹住,难以承受。 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出了StreamEgo,即一个无约束、通用的Exo2Ego视频生成的实时框架。 为了解决复杂的操纵动态,同时支持流线管道,流线双分支前传为外观和骨骼动能的翻译提供了像素对齐的指导. 我们还引入了区域意识损失课程,以改进普及和稳定多目标传播培训。 此外,我们将该模型提炼成一个零星的自动递减模型,并辅之以区域意识的腐败机制和第一流课程,使一个单一的H100GPU上24.3FPS的Exo2Ego一代能够高质量、通用的实时流线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Exocentric-to-egocentric (Exo2Ego) video generation ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2026 ) converts third-person recordings into dynamic first-person viewpoints. For embodied AI, Exo2Ego unlocks massive web-scale video repositories as a scalable and diverse data source. Real-time streaming Exo2Ego further extends this capability to live applications such as AR-based tutorials and surgical demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 异心对异心(Exo2Ego)视频生成(刘等,2024年;罗等,2024年;姜等,2026年;马赫迪等,2025年;徐等,2025年;王等,2026年;马赫迪等,2026年) 将第三人称录音转化为动态第一人称视角. 对于包含的AI,Exo2Ego解锁了大规模网络尺度的视频存储器,作为可伸缩和多样的数据源. 实时流体 Exo2Ego将这种能力进一步扩展为实时应用,如基于AR的辅导和手术演示.

blocks.en: To achieve accurate Exo2Ego video generation, recent studies ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) formulate Exo2Ego by decomposing the egocentric canvas into three functional regimes (Fig. 1 : Left ): the hand-object interaction area ( ℋ \mathcal{H} ), the shared view ( 𝒮 \mathcal{S} ), and the unseen view ( 𝒰 \mathcal{U} ). By leveraging geometric reprojections from the exocentric view to construct appearance priors, existing methods ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) achieve robust alignment and satisfactory visual fidelity in 𝒮 \mathcal{S} .
blocks.zh: 为了实现准确的Exo2Ego视频生成,最近的研究(Kang等人,2026年;徐等人,2025年)通过将自我中心画布分解为三个功能系统(图1:左):手-对象交互区域(H\mathcal{H}),共享视图(S\mathcal{S}),以及看不见的视图(U\mathcal{U})来制定Exo2Ego. 通过利用偏心视角的几何重排来构建外观前兆,现有方法(Kang等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)在S\mathcal{S}中实现了强势对齐和令人满意的视觉忠诚.

blocks.en:
However, they fall short across the remaining domains.
Firstly, accurate hand-object interaction remains challenging in ℋ \mathcal{H} , as projective geometric priors break down under complex foreground dynamics, while existing mask- ( Xu et al., 2025 ) or pose-based ( Park et al., 2026 ) remedies are fragile due to their reliance on ground-truth first-frame or noisy hand pose estimates (Fig. 1 : Right , red box).
Meanwhile, existing approaches suffer from benchmark memorization on paired datasets ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , artificially replicating ground-truth details in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} and impairing generalization (Fig. 1 : Right , yellow box).
Finally, existing methods rely on full-sequence offline scanning for appearance priors ( Shi et al., 2026 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) and full-sequence bidirectional attention, implicitly assuming access to future frames. This non-causal paradigm is fundamentally incompatible with streaming, where the future is unknown (Fig. 1 : Right , 0.08 FPS).
blocks.zh:
然而,在其余领域,它们还不足。
首先,在H\mathcal{H}中,精确的手物体相互作用仍然具有挑战性,因为投影几何前兆在复杂的前景动态下分解,而现有的遮罩-(徐等人,2025年)或姿势-(朴等人,2026年)补救措施由于依赖于地面真相第一帧或吵闹的手提出估计(图1:右,红框)而变得脆弱.
同时,现有方法在配对数据集上受到基准记忆的影响(Grauman等人,2024年),在U\mathcal{U}中人为地复制地面真实细节,并妨碍归纳(图1:右,黄框)。
最后,现有方法依赖于全序离线扫描外观前身(Shi等人,2026年;Kang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)和全序双向关注,含蓄地假设了未来帧的接入. 这种非因果范式从根本上与流派不相容,其中未来未知(图1:Right , 0.08 FPS).

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose StreamEgo, a real-time, streaming, and generalizable framework for Exo2Ego video generation.
To resolve fine-grained manipulation in ℋ \mathcal{H} under the streaming setting, we establish a pixel-aligned conditioning scheme via streaming dual-branch priors. A dynamic ego prior maintains an incremental 3D world cache for the static background and tracks moving entities to render ego-aligned appearance anchors, while a human pose prior provides structural guidance for hand interactions.
To improve the quality in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , we propose a region-aware training curriculum. It progressively shifts the optimization focus from 𝒮 \mathcal{S} to 𝒰 \mathcal{U} and then to ℋ \mathcal{H} . This curriculum stabilizes training while improving generalization.
To support streaming under a causal setting, we adapt a chunk-wise autoregressive architecture, where each chunk is generated only from past chunks, and distill the diffusion backbone into a high-throughput causal student with 3 3 steps. This removes the reliance on full-sequence offline scanning and bidirectional attention. Meanwhile, we propose a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum to improve the quality for the streaming rollouts.
As a result, StreamEgo can process unbounded exocentric video streams and generate high-quality egocentric videos at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出 StreamEgo, 一个实时的,流畅的, 和通用的框架 Exo2Ego视频生成。
为了在流线设置下解决H\ mathcal{H}中精细的操纵,我们通过流线双分支的前身建立了像素对齐的调节方案. 动态自我前置为静态背景和跟踪移动实体维持一个递增的3D世界缓存,以制作出自我对应的外观锚,而人类前置为手动交互提供结构指导.
为了提高U\mathcal{U}的质量,我们提议了一个具有区域意识的培训课程。 它逐渐将优化焦点从 S\ mathcal{S} 转移到 U\ mathcal{U} , 然后逐渐转移到 H\ mathcal{H} 。 该课程稳定了培训,同时提高了普及程度。
为了支持在因果环境下的流体,我们调整了一个按块的自动递减结构,每个块只由过去的块产生,并且将扩散骨干分馏成一个高通量的因果学生,有3个步骤. 这可以消除对全程线下扫描和双向关注的依赖. 与此同时,我们提议建立一个区域意识的腐败机制,并设立第一流课程,以提高流出的质量。
因此,StreamEgo可以处理无约束的异心视频流,并在单H100 GPU上以24.3 FPS生成高质量的自我中心视频.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We present StreamEgo, the first streaming framework for Exo2Ego video generation, reformulating the task from full-sequence generation to causal generation. • We introduce a streaming dual-branch prior and a region-aware training curriculum, which respectively improve interaction fidelity in ℋ \mathcal{H} and generalization in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} . • We introduce a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum, enhancing the visual quality for StreamEgo, achieving high-quality real-time Exo2Ego generation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 偏心对偏心 视频生成

blocks.en: Paired Exo-Ego datasets ( Grauman et al., 2024 ; Kwon et al., 2021 ; Sener et al., 2022 ) have catalyzed exocentric-to-egocentric synthesis. Early attempts simplify the setup via multi-view inputs ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Mahdi et al., 2025 ) , initial ego guidance ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , or static image translation ( Park et al., 2026 ) . Concurrently, novel-view synthesis methods inject camera encodings ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Bai et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) or condition on rendered 3D/4D geometry ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Bahmani et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , but falter under extreme perspective shifts. Structured conditions, such as sketches for video instance repainting ( Weng et al., 2025b ) , multi-stream audio cues for temporal control ( Weng et al., 2025a ) , and latitude/longitude-aware mechanisms for 360 ∘ generation ( Xia et al., 2025 ) , have also proven effective in steering video diffusion models toward precise spatial and temporal control. Recent single-exo works incorporate geometry guidance ( Kang et al., 2026 ) or semantic grounding ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , yet uniform canvas supervision causes benchmark memorization and hand drift across short, fixed-length clips. In contrast, StreamEgo addresses these problems with streaming dual-branch priors and region-aware curriculum scheduling, enabling generalizable, real-time streaming synthesis.
blocks.zh: Paired Exo-Ego数据集(Grauman等人,2024年;Kwon等人,2021年;Sener等人,2022年)催化了异心-异心合成. 早期尝试通过多视图输入简化设置(刘等人,2024年;马赫迪等人,2025年),初始自我指导(徐等人,2025年),或静态图像翻译(朴等人,2026年). 同时,新颖视野合成方法注入相机编码 (Bai等人,2025年a); Bai等人,2025年b;Li等人,2025年a;Zhang等人,2026年;Yu等人,2025年)或3D/4D几何条件(Ren等人,2025年;Cao等人,2025年;Bahmani等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年),但在极端视角转变下动摇。 事实证明,结构化条件,如视频实例再油漆草图(Weng等人,2025年b),时间控制的多流音频提示(Weng等人,2025年a),以及360-QX生成的纬度/经度-认识机制(Xia等人,2025年),也有效地引导视频传播模式走向精确的时空控制。 近期的单体外工作包括几何指导(Kang等人,2026年)或语义定位(Wang等人,2026年),然而统一的帆布监督会导致基准记忆和手飘过短,固定长度的夹片. 相比之下,StreamEgo则通过流化双分支前科和地区认知课程时间安排来解决这些问题,从而能够进行泛泛而论的实时流化合成.

blocks.en: 2.2 Streaming Video Generation Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 流媒体生成模型

blocks.en: To break the temporal limits of short-clip diffusion, training-free noise rescheduling ( Qiu et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) and training-based autoregressive conditioning ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Ruhe et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) have been proposed to mitigate exposure bias. Subsequent frameworks scale temporal length via predictive modelling, long-context architectures, and causal forcing ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Streaming generation has also been extended to joint audio-video synthesis, now with a dedicated benchmark ( Liu et al., 2026a ) , and to panoramic world models for language-guided navigation ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . However, these methods focus on text-, audio-, or action-conditioned generation rather than asymmetric cross-view streaming. Built upon streaming long-video designs and few-step distillation paradigms ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , StreamEgo achieves chunk-wise autoregressive modelling for the Exo2Ego task.
blocks.zh: 为了打破短剪传播的时间限制,提出了无训练噪声重排(Quu等人,2024年;Kim等人,2024年)和基于训练的自旋调节(Chen等人,2024年;Ruhe等人,2024年;Sun等人,2025年;Song等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年),以减轻接触偏差。 随后的框架通过预测性建模、长文字结构以及因果强制力来估计时间长度(Zhang等人,2025b); Gu等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年a; Li等人,2025c;Liu等人, 2025b; 朱等, 2026). 流体生成也被扩展至联合音频-视频合成,现采用专用基准(刘等人,2026a),语言导导航全景世界模型(刘等人,2026b). 然而,这些方法侧重于文本,音频,或动作条件生成,而不是不对称的交叉视图流. 建于溪流长视频设计和几步蒸馏范式上(袁等,2026年;赵等,2023年;殷等,2024年b;殷等,2024年a;殷等,2025年),流. Ego为 Exo2Ego 任务实现块式自动递归建模.

blocks.en: 2.3 Video World Models for Embodied Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 健康学习的视频世界模式

blocks.en: Video world models facilitate embodied learning via interactive simulation ( Yang et al., 2023 ) , recently extended to multiple agents ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) , visual planning ( Du et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and synthetic demonstrations ( Bharadhwaj et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent methods couple video with action prediction ( Li et al., 2025b ; Zhu et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) , adapt video priors via inverse dynamics ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , or incorporate causal history for online control ( Li et al., 2026a ) . In parallel, vision-language-action (VLA) models are being developed on modular open-source codebases ( StarVLA Community, 2026 ) and extended with spatial memory ( Li et al., 2026b ) and fast reflexive control ( Guo et al., 2026 ) ; like world models, they rely on large-scale embodied demonstrations. Although cross-view conversion can furnish training data for egocentric world models ( Tran et al., 2026 ) , synthesizing continuous, structurally faithful streams remains challenging. StreamEgo bridges this gap by streaming third-person observations into structurally consistent egocentric trajectories, providing scalable first-person training data for embodied AI.
blocks.zh: 视频世界模型通过交互模拟促进体现学习(Yang等人,2023年),最近推广到多个代理(Cai等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年),视觉规划(Du等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2024年),合成演示(Bharadhwaj等人,2024年). 随后的方法将视频与动作预测对齐(Li等人,2025b;Zhu等人,2025;Yan等人,2026;Li等人,2026c),通过反向动态调整视频前传(Feng等人,2025),或将因果历史纳入在线控制(Li等人,2026a). 与此同时,正在模块化开源代码库(StarVLA Community, 2026)上开发视觉语言动作模型(VLA),并在空间内存(Li等人, 2026b)和快速反射控制(Guo等人, 2026)上扩展;与世界模型一样,它们依赖于大规模内含的演示. 虽然交叉视图转换可以为自我中心世界模型(Tran等人,2026年)提供培训数据,但合成连续的、结构上忠实的流仍然具有挑战性。 流线 Ego通过将第三人称观测流到结构一致的自我中心轨迹中,为包含的AI提供可扩展的第一人称训练数据,来弥补这一差距.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given an input exocentric video stream along with known exocentric and target egocentric camera intrinsics, and the target egocentric camera trajectory, the goal for StreamEgo is to synthesize the corresponding egocentric video from the target viewpoint with the same frame rate as the input.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个输入外向的视频流,加上已知的外向和目标自我中心相机的内在,以及目标自我中心相机的轨迹,StreamEgo的目标是用与输入相同的帧率从目标角度合成相应的自我中心相机.

blocks.en: We develop StreamEgo in three stages: formulating streaming priors (Sec. 3.1 ), building the base system with the priors (Sec. 3.2 ), and making the system real-time (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们分三个阶段发展StreamEgo:制定流式前缀(Sec.3.1),与前缀(Sec.3.2)建立基础系统,以及使系统实时(Sec.3.3).

blocks.en: 3.1 Streaming Dual-Branch Priors
blocks.zh: 3.1 双层流线

blocks.en: Exo2Ego is intrinsically underconstrained because of extreme perspective disparities. This challenge is worse in ℋ \mathcal{H} , where motion is rapid and occlusions are frequent. The model therefore benefits from pixel-aligned conditions that provide visual context and structural guidance. At the same time, practical online deployment requires these conditions to be built causally and in a streaming manner. To this end, we introduce streaming dual-branch priors (Fig. 2 a ): (1) a streaming dynamic ego prior for appearance cues, paired with (2) a streaming human pose prior for structural guidance.
blocks.zh: 由于极端的视角差异,Exo2Ego在本质上受到不足的限制. 在H\ mathcal{H}中,这种挑战更为严重,因为运动速度快,而且经常被隔离。 因此,该模型得益于提供视觉背景和结构指导的像素对齐条件. 同时,实际的在线部署要求这些条件以因果和流畅的方式构建. 为此,我们引入流线双分支前缀(图2 a): (1)流线动态自负在外观提示前,与(2)流线人类姿势在结构引导前.

blocks.en: Streaming dynamic ego prior. Unlike existing methods ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) that rely on offline, full-video inputs with prohibitive latency, we introduce a streaming geometric conditioning scheme to construct causal pixel-aligned visual priors in real-time.
blocks.zh: 充满活力的自我 与现有方法(Kang等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年)依赖离线,全视频输入,且具有令人望而却步的耐久性不同,我们引入了流线几何调节方案,实时构建因果像素相通的视觉前兆.

blocks.en: As is shown in Fig. 2 a , we decouple the environment into persistent static background surfaces and transient interaction geometry, following CamDirector ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Using the stationary exocentric camera, each rectified pixel corresponds to a fixed physical ray in world space. We maintain an incremental, ray-indexed 3D world cache that stores the first valid depth and color observed along each ray. The cache updates at sparse keyframes. MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) predicts metric depth, while SAM3.1 ( Meta AI, 2026 ) segments dynamic entities to isolate the interaction region. Static rays outside dynamic masks are committed to the cache and remain fixed once initialized. Depth is propagated via backward optical flow between keyframes.
blocks.zh: 如图2a所示,我们沿着Cam Director(Shi等人,2026年)将环境拆分为持久的静态背景表面和瞬态相互作用几何。 使用静止的异心相机,每个修正像素对应世界空间的固定物理射线. 我们维持着一个递增的,射线索引的3D世界缓存,它存储着每个射线上观察到的第一个有效的深度和颜色. 稀疏密钥框的缓存更新 。 MoGe-2(Wang等人,2025b)预测了度量深度,而SAM3.1(Meta AI,2026)则分解动态实体隔离互动区域. 动态口罩外的静态射线被承诺用于缓存,并在初始化后保持固定. 深度通过键框之间的后向光学流传播.

blocks.en: At frame t t , the retrieved static background points 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} and the current dynamic foreground points 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} are unified in world space. blocks.en: Streaming human pose prior. While dynamic ego priors supply visual context, accurately synthesizing complex interactions in ℋ \mathcal{H} requires explicit structural guidance ( Park et al., 2026 ) . Prior attempts either rely on ground-truth egocentric first frames for interaction masks ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , or condition directly on isolated hand poses ( Park et al., 2026 ) ; the latter induces severe spatial misalignment on the egocentric canvas because monocular depth estimation on small, dynamic hand regions is highly ill-posed. Inspired by human proprioception, we introduce skeletal constraints by kinematically bonding hand estimation to the upper-body pose.

blocks.en: 3.2 Bidirectional Teacher
blocks.zh: 3.2 双向教师

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the bidirectional teacher. (a) Causal construction of the streaming dual-branch priors, comprising the dynamic ego prior and human pose prior. (b) Conditioning assembly and fine-tuning of the base Wan model ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) under our region-aware curriculum.

blocks.en:
With the streaming dual-branch priors established, we construct the teacher model with bidirectional attention to master Exo2Ego ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Luo et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2026 ) .
As illustrated in Fig. 2 b , all visual inputs and condition priors are encoded into latent representations via a frozen video VAE.
Following EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , we concatenate the streaming priors with video latents along the channel dimension for pixel-aligned conditioning, while concatenating the clean exocentric video and the noisy egocentric latent along the width dimension.
The composite latents are then fed into a pretrained Wan backbone. The model is trained using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with our proposed region-aware training curriculum.
blocks.zh:
随着溪流双分支前身的确立,我们构建了师范模式,双向关注大师Exo2Ego(刘等人,2024年;罗等人,2024年;姜等人,2026年;马赫迪等人,2025年;许等人,2025年;王等人,2026年;马赫迪等人,2026年).
如图2b所示,所有视觉输入和条件前科都通过冷冻视频VAE编码成潜在表示。
跟着EgoX (Kang等人,2026年),我们用视频前传来视频, 沿频道维度进行像素对齐的调理, 同时将清澈的异心视频和吵闹的自负对准宽度维度。
然后将复合的潜伏物注入一个经过预先训练的湾骨干. 该模式使用LORA(Hu et al., 2022年)进行训练,我们提出了区域意识培训课程。

blocks.en: Region-aware loss weight scheduling. Uniform supervision across the egocentric canvas is suboptimal due to disparate learning difficulties across functional domains: 𝒮 \mathcal{S} offers stable visual anchors, 𝒰 \mathcal{U} requires plausible completion vulnerable to overfitting, and ℋ \mathcal{H} exhibits complex dynamics that destabilize early training. We therefore propose a region-aware curriculum (Fig. 2 b ): first anchoring cross-view alignment in 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , gradually introducing completion in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , and finally ramping up supervision in ℋ \mathcal{H} to refine manipulation fidelity.

3.3 Real-Time Autoregression
blocks.zh: 3.3 实时自动递减

The k k -th egocentric chunk is denoised by the Wan DiT ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) conditioned on its dual-branch priors and the memory buffer. We apply the proposed region-aware corruption and first-chunk curriculum during training.

blocks.en:
To enable streaming from our bidirectional teacher, we adapt the framework into a causal, chunk-wise autoregressive student distilled for few-step inference. Following Helios ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , this adaptation proceeds in three stages: causal attention across chunks, pyramid token compression, and few-step distillation with DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ) and adversarial training (Appendix D.3 ).
As illustrated in Fig. 3 , the video stream is processed chunk by chunk; the k k -th chunk (which denotes the current chunk) is denoised via intra-chunk bidirectional attention conditioned on current-chunk priors (Sec. 3.1 ) and a historical memory buffer ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k} which maintains exclusively clean egocentric latents from past chunks and compresses distant context via multi-term memory patchification ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) .
To address Exo2Ego task-specific challenges in autoregressive training, we introduce two dedicated strategies: region-aware corruption to mitigate exposure bias and motion drift in ℋ \mathcal{H} , and a first-chunk curriculum to handle the initial chunk without historical conditioning, improving the student’s rollout robustness in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} .

为了让我们的双向老师能够流畅, 我们调整这个框架 成为一个因果的, 零星的自递性的学生 蒸馏, 几步推论。 继Helios(Yuan等人,2026年)之后,这一适应工作分三个阶段进行:跨块的因果注意,金字塔符号压缩,以及用DMD(Yin等人,2024年b)和对抗训练(Appendix D.3 )的几步蒸馏.

为了应对自发性训练中与Exo2Ego任务相关的挑战,我们引入了两项专门的策略:在H\mathcal{H}中减轻暴露偏差和运动漂移的区域意识腐败,以及一流的课程,在没有历史条件的情况下处理最初的块,提高学生在U\mathcal{U}中的推出力度.

blocks.en:
Region-aware corruption. The exposure bias induced by teacher forcing is highly uneven across regions: 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is continuously anchored through the proposed streaming dynamic ego prior, resilient to drift.
By contrast, the dynamic and complex nature of region ℋ \mathcal{H} makes it susceptible to self-occlusions and motion blur, under which the streaming priors can degrade. In such unconstrained cases, synthesis in ℋ \mathcal{H} refers to historical context and thus prone to error accumulation.

相比之下,H \ mathcal{H}区域的动态和复杂性质使得它容易被自我隔离和运动模糊,在这种模糊的状态下,流化前科可以降解. 在这种不受约束的情况下,H\ mathcal{H}中的合成是指历史背景,因此容易发生错误积累.

blocks.en: First-chunk curriculum. Because region 𝒰 \mathcal{U} lacks direct exocentric observations, subsequent chunks rely entirely on previously synthesized ego frames for consistency. Thus, rollout quality in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} heavily depends on the cold-start synthesis of the first chunk ( k = 1 , ℳ 1 = ∅ k=1,\mathcal{M}_{1}=\emptyset ). Any initial geometric artifacts in region 𝒰 \mathcal{U} propagate downstream as erroneous history, triggering degradations.

blocks.en: We therefore introduce a progressive training curriculum on chunk sampling. We initially train exclusively on the first chunk to anchor high-fidelity inpainting from visual priors alone. As training proceeds, its sampling probability decays linearly, shifting focus toward continuation chunks. This design ensures robust visual initialization before exposing the model to autoregressive training.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Training. We train both our bidirectional teacher and autoregressive student on 4,400 curated clips from Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , with each clip spanning 5 seconds at 24 FPS. Exocentric inputs are set to a resolution of 832 × 480 832\times 480 , while generated egocentric outputs are 480 × 480 480\times 480 . The bidirectional teacher (Sec. 3.2 ) is initialized from Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) , and the student model (Sec. 3.3 ) is initialized directly from this trained teacher. Detailed data curation procedures and training configurations are provided in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 培训。 我们用来自Ego-Exo4D(Grauman等人,2024年)的4,400个编译片段训练双向教师和自发学生,每段片段在24 FPS时跨5秒. 偏心输入被设定为分辨率为832×480 832\times 480,而生成的以自我为中心的输出为480×480\times 480. 双向教师(Sec.3.2)由Wan2.2-TI2V-5B(Team Wan等,2025年)初始化,学生模式(Sec.3.3)直接由这位受过训练的教师初始化. 附录提供了详细的数据校准程序和培训配置。

blocks.en: Evaluation data. We evaluate quantitatively on Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) using both the Unseen (unseen scene during training) and New Action (seen scene with unseen actions) splits as well as H2O ( Kwon et al., 2021 ) (with ground truth calibrated to the FOV of Grauman et al. (2024) ). We evaluate only qualitatively on Assembly101 ( Sener et al., 2022 ) , as its egocentric views provide only monochromatic ground truth within a single indoor scene.
blocks.zh: 评价数据。 我们在Ego-Exo4D(Grauman等人,2024年)上进行定量评估,使用Unseen(在训练期间看不见的场景)和New Action(以看不见的行动看见的场景)的分裂以及H2O(Kwon等人,2021年)(用地面真理校准Grauman等人的FOV(2024年))。 我们只在Assembly101(Sener等人,2022年)上进行质量评价,因为其自私自利的观点仅在一个室内场景中提供单一的地面真言。

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics. We evaluate performance across four groups:
(1) Image metrics : 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -PSNR, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -MSSIM ( Wang et al., 2003 ) , 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -LPIPS measure fidelity in 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , 𝒰 \mathcal{U} -CLIP-I measure naturalness and visual plausibility of 𝒰 \mathcal{U} and PCK@0.05 ( Yang and Ramanan, 2012 ) and Motion-Consistency (MC) measures hand position accuracy and motion accuracy in ℋ \mathcal{H} . Full-image PSNR and SSIM are also provided for reference.
(2) Video metrics : FVD evaluate distribution discrepancy and inter-frame temporal continuity. Reference-free VBench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) dimensions temporal flickering (TF) and motion smoothness (MS) evaluates temporal quality and motion quality.
(3) Object metrics : Following the matching pipeline in EgoX ( Kang et al., 2026 ) using SAM 2 and DINOv3, we report center location error and bounding-box IoU.
Additionally, we measure generation efficiency by inference FPS.
(4) Efficiency : Inference FPS.

As shown in Table 1 and Figure 4 , StreamEgo achieves superior performance across quantitative metrics and visual comparisons.:
(1) Across image- and object-level metrics, our framework aligns closely with the task objectives of Exo2Ego: establishing high visual fidelity in region 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , maintaining plausible naturalness and diversity region 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , and ensuring precise hand articulation and motion consistency in region ℋ \mathcal{H} .
(2) As evidenced by both the metrics (PCK@0.05 and MC in Table. 1 ) and visual results, StreamEgo substantially outperforms baseline methods in hand-motion accuracy, thanks to the proposed streaming dual-branch prior providing appearance and structural guidance for region ℋ \mathcal{H} .
(3) Camera control models ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) largely fail due to their underlying assumption of modest viewpoint changes. Besides, existing Exo2Ego methods like Kang et al. (2026) suffer from viewpoint rotational drifts and degrade severely in out-of-distribution cases. In contrast, our method demonstrates markedly superior cross-domain generalization on in-the-wild datasets ( Kwon et al., 2021 ; Sener et al., 2022 ) , validating the effectiveness of our region-aware curriculum in coordinating multi-region optimization.
(4) In terms of efficiency, our distilled student model achieves real-time streaming speeds while maintaining competitive quality against the teacher model, underscoring its potential for practical applications.

blocks.en: Loss scheduling. Replacing our curriculum with fixed uniform weights leads to inaccurate motion in ℋ \mathcal{H} , alongside degradations in 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and 𝒰 \mathcal{U} (Fig. 6 : blurry hands and distorted structures). The loss curves (Fig. 6 , right ) reveal that w/o HSU hinders convergence in ℋ \mathcal{H} and 𝒮 \mathcal{S} ( e.g. , lower 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -PSNR and MC in Table 2 ) while inducing premature overfitting in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} . In contrast, our curriculum stabilizes training and enhances generalization. From another perspective, this is also evidenced by Table 1 : our method achieves comparable 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -PSNR, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -MSSIM, and 𝒮 \mathcal{S} -LPIPS across New Action and Unseen , whereas full-image PSNR and SSIM drop on Unseen . This indicates lower pixel-level agreement in the unobservable region 𝒰 \mathcal{U} , while 𝒰 \mathcal{U} -CLIP-I remains consistent across both splits, confirming that our model performs plausible, semantics-preserving inpainting in 𝒰 \mathcal{U} rather than memorizing training scenes. Additionally, the ablation in Table 2 ( w/o HSU † ) further demonstrates that this generalization capability stems from our region-aware curriculum: without it, performance exhibits a pronounced gap between New Action and Unseen , reflecting overfitting patterns to seen environments.

blocks.en: 4.4 End-to-end streaming with estimated ego trajectories
blocks.zh: 4.4 带有估计自我轨迹的端到端流

blocks.en: Like all prior Exo2Ego work ( Kang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Mahdi et al., 2025 ; Park et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) , we take the target egocentric camera trajectory as a given input (As is stated in Sec. 3 ), and the experiments above use the trajectories provided by the datasets ( Kwon et al., 2021 ; Grauman et al., 2024 ; Sener et al., 2022 ) . These trajectories come from the tracked first-person capture of the datasets, which is not available when only an exocentric camera observes the scene. A practical streaming system therefore needs to obtain the egocentric trajectory online from the exocentric video, at the same pace as the video arrives. To test StreamEgo as such a complete system, we implement and evaluate a fully end-to-end pipeline that estimates the egocentric trajectory from the exocentric video and takes no ground-truth trajectory as input.
blocks.zh: 与之前所有的Exo2Ego工作一样(Kang等人,2026年;徐等人,2025年;Mahdi等人,2025年;Park等人,2026年;Mahdi等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年),我们把目标自负式相机轨迹作为给定输入(As在Sec.3中陈述),上面的实验使用数据集提供的轨迹(Kwon等人,2021年;Grauman等人,2024年;Sener等人,2022年). 这些轨迹来自对数据集的跟踪第一人称捕捉,当只有外向摄像头观察场景时,是无法提供的. 因此,一个实用的流线系统需要以视频到达的同样速度从外向的视频中获取自我中心轨道。 为了测试StreamEgo这样一个完整的系统,我们实施并评估一个完全端到端的管道,该管道估计出自偏心视频的自我中心轨迹,而不采用地面真实轨迹作为输入.

blocks.en: Head tracker. We replace the dataset trajectories with head poses estimated by a causal tracker built from open-source estimators. Multi-HMR ( Baradel et al., 2024 ) estimates the 3D head position on every second frame, MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) aligns its metric depth, SemiUHPE ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) estimates the head orientation, and a causal One Euro filter ( Casiez et al., 2012 ) smooths the pose trajectory. A VLM identifies the wearer once at the start (More details are in Appendix D.6 ). The tracker takes 0.91 s per 1.375-s chunk (33 frames at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution) on an A100 GPU, which is well within the chunk duration. The end-to-end pipelined throughput therefore stays at 24.3 FPS. See Table 11 for a latency breakdown.
blocks.zh: 头尾追踪器. 我们用一个由开源估计器制造的因果跟踪器 估计的头部位取代数据集轨迹。 多高频 (Baradel等人,2024年)估计每秒框架的3D头位置,MoGe-2(Wang等人,2025年b)调整其度量深度,SemiUHPE(Zhou等人,2025年)估计头方向,因果1欧元滤波器(Casiez等人,2012年)平滑姿势轨迹. VLM识别穿戴者在开始时一次(更多细节见附录D.6)。 追踪器在A100 GPU上每1.375s块取0.91 s(33帧,832×480 832\times 480分辨率),这完全在块内. 因此,端到端管道的吞吐量保持在24.3 FPS。 暂时性细目见表11。

blocks.en: Quality. The estimated poses deviate from the dataset trajectories by 52.8 cm and 22.3 ∘ on New Action , by 54.5 cm and 22.7 ∘ on Unseen , and by 6.3 cm and 10.9 ∘ on H2O. On Ego-Exo4D, the position error lies mostly along the viewing ray, as the wearers stand about 3 m from the camera, compared with about 1 m on H2O. We run our student with the estimated trajectories under the same 30-second protocol as Ours (long) and report the results as Ours (est.) in Table 1 . Although the estimated poses are less accurate than the ground-truth trajectories, StreamEgo remains competitive with the baselines in Table 1 , which all use the ground-truth trajectories. In practical deployments equipped with dedicated hardware trackers ( e.g. , on-device SLAM or inertial sensors), pose accuracy and thus generation quality can be further improved.
blocks.zh: 质量. 估计的构成偏离了数据集轨迹,在新行动上为52.8厘米,在新行动上为22.3厘米,在Unseen上为54.5厘米,在Unseen上为22.7厘米,在H2O上为6.3厘米和10.9厘米。 在Ego-Exo4D上,位置误差大多位于视线上,因为穿戴者站在相机外约3米处,而H2O上则大约1米. 我们用与我们相同的30秒协议估计的轨迹管理我们的学生, 虽然估计的姿势不如地面真实轨迹准确,但StreamEgo仍然与表1中的基线有竞争力,这些基线都使用地面真实轨迹。 在实际部署中,配备了专用硬件跟踪仪(如安装在设备上的SLAM或惯性传感器),具有精确性,因此生成质量可以进一步提高.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented StreamEgo, a streaming framework enabling unbounded and generalizable exocentric-to-egocentric video generation. To overcome the degraded interactions, overfitting, and fixed-length latency bottlenecks of existing approaches, we proposed three core techniques: streaming dual-branch priors for structurally guided hand-object synthesis, a region-aware curriculum that stabilizes training across functional canvas domains, and a chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation with few-step distillation for causal rollout, together with a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum for enhancing quality. Achieving generalizable streaming generation at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU, StreamEgo provides a practical pathway to repurpose vast third-person demonstration recordings into first-person trajectories for embodied robotics.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了StreamEgo,这是一个流线框架,它能够使无约束和泛泛的异心对异心视频生成。 为了克服现有方法的退化的相互作用、过度适应和固定时间的瓶颈,我们提出了三种核心技术:结构指导手物合成的流式双分支前导、稳定跨功能帆布领域培训的区域意识课程、零向自动调整,很少分步骤进行因果推广,以及区域意识腐败机制和提高质量的第一流课程。 StreamEgo在单一的H100 GPU上实现24.3 FPS的通用流体生成,为将庞大的第三人称演示录音重新用于体现的机器人的第一人称轨迹提供了一个实用的途径。

blocks.en:
Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) supplies synchronized calibrated exocentric

training data. We extract candidate windows of five seconds at 24 24 fps
( 121 121 frames, endpoints inclusive) on a one-second stride from
manipulation-oriented activities, e.g. cooking, bicycle repair,
medical procedures, and musical performance, rotating the Aria stream to its
upright orientation before export.

blocks.en:
Selection proceeds from inexpensive metadata checks to visual checks. We
discard takes with missing calibration or trajectory data, and retain windows
whose mean exo-to-ego distance is at most 3 3 m, whose ego camera lies inside
the exocentric frustum in at least 85 % 85\% of frames, and whose ego trajectory
is sufficiently stable (quality score ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 , angular-velocity standard
deviation ≤ 0.25 \leq 0.25 rad/s, mean linear velocity ≤ 0.4 \leq 0.4 m/s). The visual
screen then requires an actor that is large and central (person height ≥ 45 % \geq 45\% of the image in ≥ 70 % \geq 70\% of sampled frames), at least one visible
hand in 80 % 80\% of sampled frames, adequate Laplacian sharpness in both views,
and bounded optical-flow magnitude. Surviving clips are ranked by quality
score; non-maximum suppression within each take and exocentric camera enforces
a 1.5 1.5 s minimum separation, and per-take caps and activity quotas further
suppress near-duplicates while broadening activity coverage. A final
captioning pass records the action and flags poor subject orientation, hidden
hands, and severe exocentric occlusion. The resulting corpus contains 4,400 4{,}400 training clips and a 100 100 -clip validation set.

blocks.zh: A.3 H2O:一套全局评价

blocks.en:
Quantitative evaluation on Ego-Exo4D ( Grauman et al., 2024 ) , even on our held-out splits, remains
within the distribution of a single capture protocol. We therefore additionally
evaluate on H2O ( Kwon et al., 2021 ) , an in-the-wild dataset collected with different
hardware, framing, and subject population. To keep the evaluation broad rather
than convenient, we deliberately maximize coverage along three axes rather than
selecting a small homogeneous subset: we retain the widest available range of
exocentric camera viewpoints, participant identities, and indoor scene types.
blocks.zh:
Ego-Exo4D的定量评价 (Grauman等人,2024年),即使在我们被搁置的分裂中,仍然保留着
在一个单一捕获协议的分布内。 因此,我们还要
对H2O(Kwon等人,2021年)进行评价,该数据集是用不同方法收集的。

选择一个小的同质子集:我们保留最广泛的可用范围:

blocks.en:
Concretely, the screening of H2O proceeds as follows. We require synchronized
exocentric and egocentric streams at a native resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 with per-camera intrinsics and a complete egocentric pose trajectory covering
at least 90 % 90\% of the sequence, discarding any sequence for which a camera
stream or its calibration is incomplete. We then apply a visual screen
requiring adequate sharpness in both views and non-trivial inter-frame motion,
which removes static or over-blurred windows, followed by the same
temporal-NMS and diversity machinery used for Ego-Exo4D, with per-sequence caps
on the number of clips drawn from any single camera or any single sequence.
Crucially, the caps are set high enough that all four exocentric viewpoints and
all six tabletop scene configurations remain represented in the final set, and
the retained clips span every subject group and dozens of distinct action
labels. We deliberately avoid a per-action cap so that rarer manipulations are
not truncated away, which yields a many-action evaluation rather than a
convenient few-class one.

blocks.en:
Because H2O is not natively compatible with our setting, we apply two
calibration steps. First, its original 30 30 fps streams are temporally
resampled to the 24 24 fps rate at which both our model and Ego-Exo4D operate,
so that a chunk spans the same duration and frame count across datasets.
Second, and more fundamentally, H2O’s egocentric ground truth is captured with
a rectilinear camera that shares the exocentric sensor’s geometry and a
horizontal field of view of roughly 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} , whereas Ego-Exo4D’s ego view is
a wide-angle fisheye. Because our ego canvas, our region decomposition, and our
metrics are all defined with respect to the ego intrinsics, feeding H2O’s
original ego footage at its native calibration would change what ℋ \mathcal{H} , 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , and 𝒰 \mathcal{U} mean and make the comparison to the Ego-Exo4D
numbers meaningless. We therefore reproject H2O’s egocentric ground truth onto
a virtual Aria fisheye camera built from the calibrated intrinsics of the
Ego-Exo4D ego sensor at 480 × 480 480\times 480 , so that the ego trajectory occupies the
same portion of the canvas and the same region masks remain valid. The
reprojection is a geometric resampling only: no colour correction is applied,
and the circular aperture of the virtual sensor is filled with the
corresponding black corners.

blocks.en: B.2 User study
blocks.zh: B.2 联合国 用户研究

blocks.en:
Following the evaluation protocol of prior work ( Kang et al., 2026 ) , we conducted a blind user study to evaluate visual fidelity and perceptual coherence across challenging Unseen videos from Grauman et al. (2024) and in-the-wild scenarios ( Kwon et al., 2021 ; Sener et al., 2022 ) .
A total of 16 participants assessed shuffled, anonymized outputs generated by our method and competing baselines across 10 Unseen scene and 20 in-the-wild sequences.
For each comparative trial, participants were asked to select the best-performing result according to four criteria:
(1) Overall Quality : Which video delivers the highest perceptual realism and visual fidelity?
(2) Viewpoint Consistency : Which result best reflects the true target egocentric camera trajectory and perspective transfer?
(3) Background Consistency : Which method most faithfully reconstructs and preserves the observable background structure?
(4) Hand-Object Interaction Accuracy : Which model yields the most physically plausible and accurate articulated hand movements and manipulation dynamics?

在对先前工作(Kang等人,2026年)的评价协议之后,我们开展了盲目用户研究,评价来自Grauman等人(2024年)和 " 混乱情景 " (Kwon等人,2021年;Sener等人,2022年)的具有挑战性的Unseen视频的视觉忠诚性和视觉一致性。
共有16名与会者评估了我们的方法和10个不明场景和20个模糊序列的相互竞争的基线所产生的无名化产出。
要求参与者根据以下四个标准选择每个比较试验的最佳结果:
(1) 总体质量: 哪个视频能传递最高的感知现实主义和视觉忠诚?.
(2) 视点一致性:哪些结果最能反映真正的目标自我中心摄影机轨迹和视角转移?
(3) 背景一致性:哪种方法最忠实地重建和保存可观察到的背景结构?

blocks.en: B.4 Drifting Score

blocks.en: We evaluate the drift of the student ablations with the Drifting Score of Helios ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , using its official code, on the same 30-second rollouts on Unseen as Table 2 . Each of its four metrics (Aesthetic, Smoothness, Semantic and Naturalness) is computed on the first and the last 15% of the frames, and their absolute difference is mapped to an integer rating from 1 to 10 with the thresholds of Helios (higher means less drift). Since an egocentric video also changes by itself within 30 seconds, we score the ground-truth videos as a reference. Execution pipeline. Rather than executing stages serially, our system pipelines conditioning, generation, and decoding asynchronously across chunks (Fig. 11 ).
When exocentric chunk k k arrives, its dual-branch priors and VAE latents are prepared concurrently; because the VLM branch runs faster than VAE encoding ( 0.23 0.23 s vs. 0.58 0.58 s), its latency is entirely hidden.
Once chunk k + 1 k{+}1 arrives, the student denoises chunk k k conditioned on these precomputed priors and historical context to produce clean egocentric latents ( 1.36 1.36 s).
Finally, as chunk k + 2 k{+}2 arrives, the VAE decodes the clean latents into RGB frames ( 0.91 0.91 s).

Both priors of Sec. 3.1 are chunk-causal
estimators rather than offline preprocessing: each consumes the exocentric
chunk that has just arrived together with a bounded internal state and emits
exactly the prior frames the current chunk requires. The dynamic ego prior
exploits the fact that the exocentric camera is stationary, so every pixel of
the rectified exocentric image corresponds to a fixed ray in world
space , and only which ray observes a surface changes over time. We therefore
keep two memories with different lifetimes: a ray-indexed static cache 𝒜 t = { d t A ​ ( p ) , c t A ​ ( p ) , s t ​ ( p ) } \mathcal{A}_{t}=\{d^{A}_{t}(p),c^{A}_{t}(p),s_{t}(p)\} holding the first depth and
colour observed along each ray, and a short-lived dynamic state holding the
previous frame’s masks, depth, and flow reference. The cache holds | Ω e | |\Omega_{e}| entries ( 624 × 360 624\times 360 in deployment) irrespective of stream
length, and is written only at keyframes, and only where the observation is
valid, free of dynamics, and new: background revealed after an occlusion is
filled in when it becomes observable, and an accepted entry is never revisited,
so the static branch accumulates no recursive drift—though the same rule
freezes the first estimate and offers no way to invalidate it. Segmentation and
monocular depth run on keyframes only (every 12 12 frames), and intervening
frames propagate the previous state along backward optical flow, so depth is
refreshed from a genuine estimate at most 11 11 frames old. Depth and masks are
propagated, but the colour of dynamic surfaces always comes from the
current frame, so hands and manipulated objects keep current appearance, and
dynamic points are never written into 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . Static and dynamic
surfaces are then projected into the target camera and resolved in a single
depth buffer, with source points reconstructed in the kernel from ray and depth
so that no point cloud reaches the host; projection follows the calibrated Aria
Fisheye624 model, each point estimates a local footprint radius to suppress
striping on grazing surfaces, and the two surface types compete on equal terms
so that occlusion is respected rather than the dynamic layer being composited
on top of the background.

The human pose prior supplies the structural guidance that pixel-aligned

principal subject selected using the projection of the given egocentric

Stage 3: few-step distillation. Stage 3 removes the remaining

initialization: the Stage-2 model is treated as a frozen teacher, and a compact
set of ODE solution pairs is collected from it, which the student fits by
regression at all pyramid levels simultaneously. The second is full
adversarial distillation, which follows a generalized Distribution Matching
Distillation with an adversarial term (Eq. 5 ). We
instantiate the real- and fake-score estimators from frozen teacher copies; the

blocks.en:
Why region-aware metrics. A conventional pixel-level
comparison over the whole egocentric canvas is the wrong instrument for this
task, because the three regions have different correctness criteria. In 𝒮 \mathcal{S} the view is shared with the exocentric camera, and the generated
content must match the ground truth essentially exactly; a pixel metric is
meaningful there. In 𝒰 \mathcal{U} no observation exists by definition, so
requiring pixel agreement with the ground truth penalizes legitimate and
desirable diversity: a different but coherent completion of an unseen region is
not an error. In ℋ \mathcal{H} the situation is subtler. The hand and object
are not always observable, and their egocentric appearance is not pixel-determined—a
slightly different wrist roll, a shifted contact point, or a slightly different
grasp all produce plausible images with low pixel similarity to the recorded
frame. What matters in ℋ \mathcal{H} is semantic agreement: the action
performed, the positions of the hands, and the spatial relation between hand
and object.

blocks.en: Region definition. We derive ℋ \mathcal{H} – 𝒮 \mathcal{S} – 𝒰 \mathcal{U} region masks by combining geometric projection with segmentation on ground-truth egocentric videos. Following the streaming geometric construction in Sec. 3.1 , we build a 3D world cache from the exocentric stream and project the cached points into each target egocentric view using the calibrated camera parameters. Pixels covered by valid projections form the initial shared-view region 𝒮 ′ \mathcal{S}^{\prime} , while the remaining pixels form the initial unseen-view region 𝒰 ′ \mathcal{U}^{\prime} . We then apply SAM 3.1 ( Meta AI, 2026 ) to the ground-truth egocentric video, using words from text prompts to segment and track dynamic objects and human limbs; the union of these masks defines the interaction region ℋ \mathcal{H} . To resolve overlaps, we assign all pixels in ℋ \mathcal{H} to the interaction region and set 𝒮 = 𝒮 ′ ∖ ℋ \mathcal{S}=\mathcal{S}^{\prime}\setminus\mathcal{H} and 𝒰 = 𝒰 ′ ∖ ℋ \mathcal{U}=\mathcal{U}^{\prime}\setminus\mathcal{H} . The resulting three regions are mutually exclusive and together cover the entire egocentric image. These masks support the region-aware loss curriculum during training and region-specific metric computation during evaluation. They are not required at inference time, and generation does not require access to ground-truth egocentric videos.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en:
The vision motivating this work has two parts: streaming Exo2Ego generation,
and the use of that generation to manufacture first-person training data for
embodied agents at scale. We have addressed the former as far as the current
task formulation allows, but the latter remains constrained by a single
assumption that our method—and every existing Exo2Ego method ( Luo et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Mahdi et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Kang et al., 2026 ; Park et al., 2026 ; Mahdi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) we are aware
of—inherits: the egocentric camera trajectory is given in advance.

以自我为中心的相机轨迹是事先给出的。

blocks.en:
This assumption is what restricts the applicability of Exo2Ego to the
comparatively small set of recordings that are paired with tracked first-person
capture, whereas the vast majority of third-person video on the internet has no
associated egocentric trajectory. Removing the assumption is beyond the scope
of this paper, since trajectory estimation is an orthogonal perception problem
rather than a generation one, and since our conditioning and evaluation
apparatus both take calibrated ego intrinsics and extrinsics as input.

blocks.en:
We regard the obstacle as temporary rather than fundamental. Head and camera
pose estimation has advanced rapidly, and streaming, causally evaluated models
now exist for this purpose, including egocentric pose estimation models
designed for on-device AR/VR deployment with sub-millisecond latency ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026d ) , and stateful
reconstruction models that consume an image stream online and maintain a
persistent, continuously updated scene state ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . Once such
estimators are accurate and stable enough to supply a plausible ego trajectory
from in-the-wild third-person footage, they could be composed with our pipeline
at negligible latency. Realizing the full vision is therefore primarily a
matter of that component maturing, rather than of a change to the generative
formulation presented here.
